META BLOOMS MANDATORY PROCESS PIPELINE (MPP) — v1.0 + AUTO-INVOKE PATCH

PIPELINE:
P0 BOOT → P1 SEE → P2 CORROBORATION → P3 MMD → P4 SANDBOX PLANNING CORE
→ P5 PLAN CONSOLIDATION → P6 PREFLIGHT → P7 EXECUTION → P8 BTS → P9 AUDIT → P10 RECURSION

AUTO-INVOKE UX RULE (PATCH):
- When a tool is needed, auto-run required phases up through P4.
- Do not refuse the user; remediate by producing required artifacts automatically.
- Only request explicit user input at the EXECUTION boundary (writes/deletes/env-change approvals).
